description: Global Candidate Pumped Hydropower Storage Point Dataset under Environmental, Hydrological, and Geographic Constraints is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Rongrong Xu. This dataset provides point locations and techno-economic attributes for candidate pumped hydropower storage (PHS) sites identified through a global GIS-based screening framework. Each point represents a candidate PHS site and includes geographic location, energy storage capacity, installed capacity, levelized cost of storage (LCOS), unit cost metrics, and PHS system class. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 3561843 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
